currentTarget: Habilitar la preferencia de plegado de duplicados de búsqueda
head: 130462c56f75d3c8fc2a90663a48c0474ad1208b
proposedTarget: Habilitar la preferencia para agrupar duplicados en los resultados de búsqueda.
rationale: The checkbox preference folds likely duplicate search results into one review row. The current phrase is understandable but unnatural; this wording names the search results being grouped.

currentTarget: 启用搜索重复折叠首选项

proposedTarget: 启用将重复搜索结果合并显示的偏好设置
rationale: The caller describes folding duplicate search results into one review row. The current phrase reads as search for duplicate-folding preferences; this wording states the preference to combine duplicate results.

rationale: The caller says likely duplicate results are folded into one review row. The current transliteration of folding is unclear; this wording describes grouping duplicate search results.

currentTarget: Aktivieren Sie die Sucheinstellung für die Faltung von Duplikaten
head: 130462c56f75d3c8fc2a90663a48c0474ad1208b
proposedTarget: Aktivieren Sie die Einstellung zum Zusammenfassen doppelter Suchergebnisse.
rationale: The current translation is understandable but uses an awkward noun construction. The checkbox controls whether duplicate search results are grouped into one row.

currentTarget: 重複検索の折りたたみ設定を有効にする

rationale: The caller describes combining duplicate results into a single row. The current phrase can read as duplicate searches rather than duplicate search results.

proposedTarget: Activer la préférence de regroupement des résultats de recherche en double

head: 130462c56f75d3c8fc2a90663a48c0474ad1208b
proposedTarget: Ativar a preferência para agrupar resultados de pesquisa duplicados

proposedTarget: 검색 결과의 중복 항목을 묶는 설정 활성화

rationale: The current phrase is unnatural and does not clearly identify duplicate search results. The caller says likely duplicates are combined into one review row.

proposedTarget: Bật tùy chọn gộp các kết quả tìm kiếm trùng lặp
rationale: The current phrase incorrectly attaches duplicate-folding to searching. The caller describes grouping duplicate search results into one row.

currentTarget: Aktifkan preferensi pelipatan duplikat pencarian
head: 130462c56f75d3c8fc2a90663a48c0474ad1208b
proposedTarget: Aktifkan preferensi untuk mengelompokkan hasil pencarian duplikat
rationale: The current construction is awkward. The caller identifies this as a preference that groups duplicate search results into a single row.

currentTarget: Habilite un inicio estricto y solicite comprobaciones de refuerzo para implementaciones expuestas.
head: 130462c56f75d3c8fc2a90663a48c0474ad1208b
proposedTarget: Habilite las comprobaciones estrictas de inicio y de endurecimiento de las solicitudes para implementaciones expuestas.
rationale: The security tooltip describes strict startup checks and request hardening. The current wording turns request hardening checks into a request to perform checks.
sourceKey: Enable strict startup and request hardening checks for exposed deployments.

currentTarget: सख्त स्टार्टअप सक्षम करें और उजागर तैनाती के लिए सख्त जांच का अनुरोध करें।
head: 130462c56f75d3c8fc2a90663a48c0474ad1208b
proposedTarget: उजागर डिप्लॉयमेंट के लिए सख्त स्टार्टअप और अनुरोधों की सुरक्षा सुदृढ़ करने वाली जाँचें सक्षम करें।
rationale: The tooltip concerns hardening requests in exposed deployments; the current translation says to request checks, changing the relationship of “request hardening checks.”
sourceKey: Enable strict startup and request hardening checks for exposed deployments.

currentTarget: 厳密な起動を有効にし、公開された展開の強化チェックを要求します。
head: 130462c56f75d3c8fc2a90663a48c0474ad1208b
proposedTarget: 公開環境で、厳格な起動時チェックとリクエストのセキュリティ強化チェックを有効にします。
rationale: The tooltip describes startup and request-hardening checks. The current wording reads as requesting hardening checks rather than checks that harden requests.
sourceKey: Enable strict startup and request hardening checks for exposed deployments.

currentTarget: Activez un démarrage strict et demandez des contrôles de renforcement pour les déploiements exposés.
head: 130462c56f75d3c8fc2a90663a48c0474ad1208b
proposedTarget: Activez les contrôles stricts au démarrage et de renforcement des requêtes pour les déploiements exposés.
rationale: The current translation makes “request” a verb and says to request hardening checks. The source means checks for startup and request hardening.
sourceKey: Enable strict startup and request hardening checks for exposed deployments.

currentTarget: Habilite inicialização rigorosa e solicite verificações de proteção para implantações expostas.
head: 130462c56f75d3c8fc2a90663a48c0474ad1208b
proposedTarget: Habilite as verificações rigorosas de inicialização e de reforço de segurança das solicitações para implantações expostas.
rationale: The current phrase says to request checks rather than enable request-hardening checks. The caller is a tooltip for web security hardening.
sourceKey: Enable strict startup and request hardening checks for exposed deployments.

currentTarget: تمكين بدء التشغيل الصارم وطلب إجراء فحوصات مشددة لعمليات النشر المكشوفة.
head: 130462c56f75d3c8fc2a90663a48c0474ad1208b
proposedTarget: فعّل فحوصات بدء التشغيل الصارمة وفحوصات تعزيز أمان الطلبات لعمليات النشر المكشوفة.
rationale: The current Arabic wording says to request checks. The source refers to strict startup checks and checks that harden requests.
sourceKey: Enable strict startup and request hardening checks for exposed deployments.

currentTarget: Cho phép khởi động nghiêm ngặt và yêu cầu kiểm tra tăng cường đối với các hoạt động triển khai bị lộ.
head: 130462c56f75d3c8fc2a90663a48c0474ad1208b
proposedTarget: Bật các kiểm tra khởi động nghiêm ngặt và kiểm tra tăng cường bảo mật cho yêu cầu đối với các triển khai bị lộ.
rationale: The current wording treats request as a verb (“request checks”). The security tooltip refers to hardening requests in exposed deployments.
sourceKey: Enable strict startup and request hardening checks for exposed deployments.

currentTarget: Aktifkan startup yang ketat dan minta pemeriksaan pengerasan untuk penerapan yang terbuka.
head: 130462c56f75d3c8fc2a90663a48c0474ad1208b
proposedTarget: Aktifkan pemeriksaan startup yang ketat dan penguatan keamanan permintaan untuk penerapan yang terekspos.
rationale: The current translation says to request checks; the source describes checks for strict startup and request hardening.
sourceKey: Enable strict startup and request hardening checks for exposed deployments.

currentTarget: Habilite políticas de rescate de bajo rendimiento para descargas en cola o detenidas.
head: 130462c56f75d3c8fc2a90663a48c0474ad1208b
proposedTarget: Habilite políticas de recuperación para descargas con bajo rendimiento que estén en cola o atascadas.
rationale: The caller names rescue mode for queued or stalled downloads. This makes clear that the policies rescue underperforming downloads, rather than being low-performance policies.
sourceKey: Enable underperformance rescue policies for queued or stalled downloads.

currentTarget: कतारबद्ध या रुके हुए डाउनलोड के लिए अंडरपरफॉर्मेंस बचाव नीतियों को सक्षम करें।
head: 130462c56f75d3c8fc2a90663a48c0474ad1208b
proposedTarget: कतार में मौजूद या अटकी हुई डाउनलोड के प्रदर्शन में सुधार के लिए बचाव नीतियाँ सक्षम करें।
rationale: The current phrase relies on an unclear transliteration of underperformance. The caller describes rescue mode for queued or stalled downloads.
sourceKey: Enable underperformance rescue policies for queued or stalled downloads.

currentTarget: Aktivieren Sie Rettungsrichtlinien für leistungsschwache Dateien für in der Warteschlange befindliche oder blockierte Downloads.
head: 130462c56f75d3c8fc2a90663a48c0474ad1208b
proposedTarget: Aktivieren Sie Rettungsrichtlinien für leistungsschwache Downloads, die sich in der Warteschlange befinden oder festhängen.
rationale: The current translation calls the downloads “files” and makes them the subject of low performance. The caller is a rescue-mode policy for queued or stalled downloads.
sourceKey: Enable underperformance rescue policies for queued or stalled downloads.

currentTarget: Habilite políticas de resgate de baixo desempenho para downloads enfileirados ou paralisados.
head: 130462c56f75d3c8fc2a90663a48c0474ad1208b
proposedTarget: Habilite políticas de recuperação para downloads com baixo desempenho que estejam na fila ou parados.
rationale: This clarifies that rescue policies address underperforming downloads in the queue or stalled state. The existing phrase is understandable but less clear about what has low performance.
sourceKey: Enable underperformance rescue policies for queued or stalled downloads.

currentTarget: تمكين سياسات الإنقاذ ذات الأداء الضعيف للتنزيلات الموجودة في قائمة الانتظار أو المتوقفة.
head: 130462c56f75d3c8fc2a90663a48c0474ad1208b
proposedTarget: فعّل سياسات استعادة التنزيلات ضعيفة الأداء الموجودة في قائمة الانتظار أو المتوقفة.
rationale: The current Arabic phrase can describe rescue policies that themselves perform poorly. The caller identifies policies for rescuing queued or stalled downloads.
sourceKey: Enable underperformance rescue policies for queued or stalled downloads.

currentTarget: Kích hoạt các chính sách cứu hộ kém hiệu quả đối với các bản tải xuống bị xếp hàng hoặc bị đình trệ.
head: 130462c56f75d3c8fc2a90663a48c0474ad1208b
proposedTarget: Bật chính sách phục hồi các lượt tải xuống hoạt động kém khi đang chờ hoặc bị đình trệ.
rationale: The current phrase means ineffective rescue policies. The caller describes rescue policies for underperforming downloads that are queued or stalled.
sourceKey: Enable underperformance rescue policies for queued or stalled downloads.

currentTarget: Aktifkan kebijakan penyelamatan kinerja buruk untuk unduhan yang antri atau terhenti.
head: 130462c56f75d3c8fc2a90663a48c0474ad1208b
proposedTarget: Aktifkan kebijakan pemulihan untuk unduhan berperforma buruk yang mengantre atau macet.
rationale: This makes the target of the rescue policies clear: underperforming downloads that are queued or stalled.
sourceKey: Enable underperformance rescue policies for queued or stalled downloads.

currentTarget: Activer les limites de vitesse programmées pour le téléchargement
head: 130462c56f75d3c8fc2a90663a48c0474ad1208b
proposedTarget: Activer les limites de vitesse d’envoi programmées
rationale: The caller is the upload-speed checkbox. Téléchargement ordinarily means download in French, reversing the transfer direction from upload.

currentTarget: تمكين حدود سرعة التحميل المجدولة
head: 130462c56f75d3c8fc2a90663a48c0474ad1208b
proposedTarget: تمكين حدود سرعة الرفع المجدولة
rationale: The field is specifically the upload speed-limit checkbox. الرفع distinguishes upload from download, which the current التحميل can mean.

currentTarget: تمكين جداول التحميل
head: 130462c56f75d3c8fc2a90663a48c0474ad1208b
proposedTarget: تمكين جداول الرفع
rationale: This checkbox enables upload schedules. الرفع names upload clearly; the current التحميل can be read as downloading.

proposedTarget: {title} सक्षम करें। बंद किए गए ऑटोमेशन प्रीसेट भी दिखते रहते हैं, ताकि आप जान सकें कि क्या सेटअप करना है।
rationale: The caller is an automation recipe, not a food dish. The current व्यंजन means dishes; this keeps the automation-template meaning and explains why disabled items remain visible.
sourceKey: Enable {title}. Disabled recipes remain visible so setup work is discoverable.

currentTarget: Kích hoạt {title}. Các công thức nấu ăn bị vô hiệu hóa vẫn hiển thị để có thể khám phá công việc thiết lập.

proposedTarget: Bật {title}. Các mẫu tự động hóa đã tắt vẫn hiển thị để bạn dễ tìm các bước cần thiết lập.
rationale: The caller is an automation recipe, not a cooking recipe. The current công thức nấu ăn explicitly means recipes for food; this uses automation templates and preserves the setup-discovery explanation.
sourceKey: Enable {title}. Disabled recipes remain visible so setup work is discoverable.

proposedTarget: Yêu cầu trong Danh sách mong muốn đã bật và cần được duyệt tải xuống thủ công.

sourceKey: Enabled wishlist request with manual download approval.
